g.text: Assurance and attraction returns interact: all 16 fixed-state assays
128 independent histories per condition; bars: 95% history-bootstrap intervals. Fixed-state perturbations, not evolved endpoints.
Contribution = 0.5 × (outcross maternal + paternal) + viable self offspring; no inference of realized selection or population growth.
